cohort: A female newborn with a prenatal diagnosis of omphalocele and identified 19p13.3 microdeletion, including the MAP2K2 gene.
finding: This case supports the 19p13.3 microdeletion as a contiguous gene syndrome and highlights that subjects with CFCS, including those with 19p13.3 deletions, may present with associated gastrointestinal defects such as omphalocele and hypertrophic pyloric stenosis.
